algorithm: In order K17,K18,M1,M2, draw one-based UHO line ordinals without replacement with Python random.Random(cell_seed).sample. Accept in sample order after first-four-field exclusion against every archived FEN and each earlier accepted line. Preserve source text with an LF delimiter. Initial sample size is twice the requested count plus 32. If exhausted, restart deterministically with twice the sample size.

historical.glob: job*/raw/**/*.pgn under forge-combo29/sol for jobs 1 through 27, including each D2s shard
historical.scope: All FEN tags, including controls, cut matches and unfinished games
